syn: Xian Wang de Richang Shenghuo 6th Season
The Daily Life of the Immortal King 6th Season
d.synopsis: Following the birth of his younger sister, Wang Nuan, Wang Ling’s shadow unexpectedly develops its own consciousness. It manifests as "Wang Ying"—a figure possessing a personality diametrically opposed to Wang Ling’s: domineering, cold, and ruthless. Wang Ying launches the "Shadow Gate" app, using the "Shadow Art" technique as bait to incite a "Shadow Revolution" that sweeps across the entire cultivation world. Entranced by the shortcut to power offered by shadow cultivation, unsuspecting cultivators find themselves being gradually possessed—and ultimately supplanted—by their own shadows. As his former friends fall deeper into this trap, Wang Ling is forced to confront the greatest threat—one born from his very own being. He must break all his seals, unleash the full extent of his Immortal King power, and—joining forces with his sister and companions—take a stand against Wang Ying.
